subject: Clarify token mix & $/1M target — Novacorp pilot sizing and context tiers
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap & a few sizing questions from today's call

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the time today. Quick written recap so we have a single source of truth and a couple of data points that will help me give a clean pilot pricing recommendation:

Call summary (2 lines):
- Novacorp demo use-case: customer support summarization + agent assist for enterprise accounts (priority: accuracy + sub-200ms latency for UI).
- Pilot goal: validate context fidelity at 8k/32k and measure total token mix across prompt vs. completion.

Info we discussed / what I still need:
1) Average prompt size (tokens) across workloads — can you confirm a ballpark mean?
2) Average completion (response) size — mean and 90th percentile if available.
3) Percent of requests that will need larger context windows: approx split across 8k / 32k / 128k.
4) Expected monthly token volume range for pilot phase (low / expected / high).
5) Your target unit-econ for evaluation: do you have a $/1M tokens target (or target range) we should aim for in our pricing proposal?

What I'll deliver after these numbers: a one-page pilot pricing spreadsheet with:
- Hosted vs reserved (dedicated) pricing paths and the unit $/1M impact
- Latency SLO implications for each context tier
- Recommended initial commit (tokens/month) for cost predictability

I've attached the short notes from the call and a sample pricing template (column headers only) to make it easier to populate.

Next steps: if you can reply with the five data points above by EOD Thursday, I'll send back a pilot quote and two consumption scenarios (conservative / aggressive). Also happy to slot a 20-min follow-up.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: novacorp-call-notes.csv (call timestamps + demo steps), redwood-pilot-pricing.xlsx (blank template)
From: Elaine Park <elaine@novacorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap & a few sizing questions from today's call

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the recap — really helpful. Below are the numbers we have from our telemetry and product team estimates for the initial pilot (2–3 months):

- Avg prompt tokens: 120 tokens (median ~100, mean ~120)
- Avg completion tokens: 480 tokens (median ~350, mean ~480); 90th percentile ~1,200 tokens
- Context tier split (estimated): 85% of requests fit within 8k, 12% require 32k, ~3% will need 128k (these 3% are long-customer-history stitching)
- Monthly token volume (pilot): low 40M tokens / expected 55M / high 70M
- Internal budget target: aiming for $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens for the pilot evaluation phase; procurement prefers to see both hosted and committed pricing scenarios

Procurement looped in for contracting questions. Also attaching our SOC2 questions.

Happy to chat if you want to clarify how we measured the 128k tail.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of AI & Data Products, Novacorp
elaine@novacorp.com | +1 (312) 555-0190

Attachment: novacorp-soc2-questions.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap & a few sizing questions from today's call

Elaine — thanks for the details, this is exactly what we need. Based on those figures I'm attaching a short pilot pricing note (attached) and summary below so you can share with procurement. High-level options we recommend for the pilot: 

1) Hosted (pay-as-you-go) — fastest to start
   - Unit economics estimate: $1,050 per 1M tokens (baseline) with expected true cost in the $950–$1,150 range depending on 32k/128k mix.
   - Pros: no commit, easy to spin up. Cons: higher variability; heavy 128k tail increases $/1M.

2) Dedicated reserved (3-month commit) — best for predictable $/1M
   - Recommend commit: 50M tokens/month for pilot (split: 85% 8k, 12% 32k, 3% 128k).
   - Unit economics with 50M/month commit: target $850 per 1M tokens (shows ~19% discount vs hosted baseline).
   - We can tier the discount: higher commits drop to $750/1M at 100M/month.

Assumptions & notes:
- Completion-heavy mix (prompt:completion ~1:4 on tokens) drives most cost; your 480 avg completion aligns with our compute profile used for the draft numbers.
- The 128k requests are small volume but disproportionately increase GPU memory pressure and can raise per-token cost if many coincide; we model 128k overhead as ~2.5x token-equivalent cost per request for SLO-sensitive routes.
- We'll instrument prefix caching and response truncation options to reduce 128k cost in the pilot without losing fidelity on the 8k/32k requests.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Novacorp confirms which pricing path procurement prefers (Hosted vs Dedicated commit) and whether you want the 3-month pilot commit or pay-as-you-go.
- We prepare a scoped SOW + pilot pricing spreadsheet (I attached the filled pricing workbook).
- Schedule a 30-min handoff with your engineering and our infra lead to scope traffic shaping and KV cache settings (I propose next Tue 10am PT).

If you want, I can also show a micro-sim of the unit economics that assumes a shifted mix (e.g., if 32k jumps to 20%).

Thanks —
Rishi
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Novacorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>

Rishi / team —

Thanks for the pricing options. Procurement prefers the Dedicated reserved 3-month pilot path if we can get the $850/1M level on a 50M/month commit, plus a formal SLA clause for context windows up to 32k with a defined fallback for 128k. Please prepare:

- Draft SOW + pilot pricing (DocuSign link preferred)
- Redlined SLA with explicit 32k availability and graceful degradation policy for 128k windows
- Responses to SOC2 questions (we attached earlier)

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/novacorp/redwood/sow/5473

We will also need an itemized list of attachment items you'll provide during the pilot (logs, latency dashboards, cost reports).
